_comment: Maps the ML engine's decision text to the problem-statement vocabulary (reuse / repurpose / recycle). Additive layer: engine logic is never changed. 'application_keys' must be filled from engines/ml/configs/workloads.yaml (look at the workload names/labels there).

labels.REUSE: Reuse: second life in a vehicle (low-speed EV)
labels.REPURPOSE: Repurpose: second life in stationary storage
labels.INSPECT: Inspect: manual inspection required before any decision
labels.NO_DECISION: No decision: data not sufficient or not trustworthy

registry_status_expectation._comment: What the user's registry lifecycle_status (a plain SOH threshold rule) would expect the engine's disposition to be. Used only to compare the two in fleet_reports; it never changes a decision.
